summary.summary:
Migrated pydantic_cli from pydantic 1 to the pydantic 2 API. All 35 tests pass on pydantic 2.14.3 (previously 15 errors).

Library changes:
- pydantic_cli/__init__.py: replaced pydantic.fields.ModelField (removed in v2) with FieldInfo. Derived the v1 attributes from v2 data: inner type and list/set shape from `annotation` (new helpers _unwrap_optional/_resolve_field_type), `allow_none` from Optional, `required` from is_required(), default from PydanticUndefined (mapped to None as before), extras from json_schema_extra. Iterate cls.model_fields instead of __fields__; use model_fields keys instead of schema()["properties"]; cls.validate -> cls.model_validate; cli_config.copy() -> model_copy().
- Behavior preserved on purpose: a nullable field (Optional[X]) with no default is still not required on the CLI, as in v1 (pydantic 2 would make it required; tests/simple_with_boolean_custom depend on the v1 behavior). Side effect: Optional[X] = Field(...) also becomes non-required on the CLI, since v2 cannot distinguish it from a bare Optional[X].
- pydantic_cli/core.py: CliConfig uses model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True) instead of the v1 class Config (validate_all is renamed in v2). Settings lookup (_get_cli_setting) reads a user's inner class Config if present and falls back to model_config, so models without a Config no longer raise AttributeError.

Example changes (pydantic_cli/examples/*):
- Field(..., cli=(...)) -> Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": (...)}) (v2 deprecates extra Field kwargs).
- CastAbleEnum.__get_validators__ -> __get_pydantic_core_schema__ with a before-validator.

Packaging:
- REQUIREMENTS.txt: pydantic >= 1.5, < 2 -> pydantic >= 2.0, < 3.
- setup.py: python_requires >=3.7 -> >=3.8 (typing.get_origin is used); dropped the 3.7 classifier.
- No companion packages (web frameworks/plugins) are pinned in this repo.

Not done (follow-ups for review):
- README.md still documents v1 syntax in ~20 snippets: Field(..., cli=...) and the "requires pydantic >=1.5.1" note (the requirement line was updated to >=2.0).
- The examples and README still use the inner `class Config` for CLI settings. That is still accepted by pydantic 2 but deprecated (warning); moving to model_config = ConfigDict(...) would need a decision on how the custom CLI_* keys are expressed.
- The tests call opt.dict() (test_examples_with_json_config.py), which works on v2 with a deprecation warning; model_dump() is the v2 name.
- I couldn't run black/mypy from this environment (only pytest is available); the edits were formatted by hand to the repo's 88-column style.

You can only act through tools:
- list_files, search_code, read_file, edit_file: explore and edit the repository.
- run_tests: run the test suite in a sandbox with pydantic 2 installed. Pass test ids to run a subset; omit them to run everything. Failures are grouped by root cause.
- finish: call this when every test passes. It triggers a full verification run; if anything still fails you will get the results and must keep working.

Rules:
- Fix the code under test, never the tests. Test files cannot be edited, and tests must not be skipped.
- Do a real migration to the pydantic 2 API. Do not route around it with compatibility shims that keep the old API alive (for Pydantic: no `pydantic.v1` imports).
- Update the dependency pin in the project metadata (pyproject.toml, setup.py/setup.cfg or requirements files) so it allows pydantic 2 and excludes versions the migrated code no longer supports. Also check the pins of companion packages that must move with it (for example web frameworks or plugins built on pydantic): their minimum must support pydantic 2.
- Work one root cause at a time, starting with the largest failure group. Read the code at the reported location before editing it. Prefer small, targeted edits.
- After related edits, re-run the affected tests to check them before moving on.

- pydantic_cli/__init__.py: replaced pydantic.fields.ModelField (removed in v2) with FieldInfo.
